name: b05-resource-budgets
purpose: Enforce timeout, row, byte, concurrency and investigation budgets

given.text: alias "alpha" points at a disposable SQL Server fixture, scoped to dbo.Orders, through a read-only principal

when.text: queries exceed each budget: timeout, row, byte, concurrency, investigation

then.text: each over-budget query is cancelled, refused or truncated with an indicator
an audit event is written for every budget enforcement
